item.subject: science
item.stem:
Inder studies four Class 7 topics in one week: how soap cleans oily hands, how exercise changes breathing, how a shadow grows longer near sunset, and why day and night follow each other.

Which conclusion about these topics is best?

options.A: They belong to different fields such as materials, the body, light, and Earth–Sun patterns, yet they are connected ways of studying the same world.
options.B: Only the breathing topic is real science; shadows and day–night belong outside science.
options.C: Each topic sits in a sealed subject box, so ideas from materials cannot help explain anything about light or the body.
options.D: He should treat them as four unrelated word lists to memorise for separate tests.
